script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now, Earth sign. Saturn in Aries is opposing your ruling planet Venus in Libra, creating a serious test of commitment in your 12th house of secrets and subconscious. Meanwhile, Jupiter in Aquarius is trining Venus, offering expansion in your 10th house of career. In love, if you're single, the Jupiter trine in your 6th house suggests meeting someone through your daily work routine; if you're taken, the Saturn opposition warns against hiding things from your partner in the 7th house of partnerships. Career-wise, Jupiter's influence in your 10th house brings a professional breakthrough that could lead to recognition, while financially, focus on your 2nd house of income as an unexpected bonus might be lurking there. One unexpected gift from a friend in your 11th house is coming your way today. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see what's next for Taurus.
